failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial case state is returned; a failed case raises before output assembly.

title.zh: 完整 SI 流体案例状态

scope: Independent basis: the fixed source constants are compared against published values rather than copied -- c**2 is exact by the SI definition of the metre, and epsilon0, k_B, the elementary charge and the proton mass reproduce the CODATA-2014 literals.

Every derived scale is recomputed at 40 mpmath digits from the declared deck inputs through the published relations v_t = sqrt(2 k_B T/m), omega_c = qB0/m, omega_p**2 = n q**2/(eps0 m), rho = sqrt(k_B T/m)/omega_c, k_n = 1/max|rho|, omega_n = min|omega_c|, and vA and mu0 from c2 and epsilon0.
Test matrix: all five declared cases (BONK 1/2/3, EM 1/2), each checking every derived vector element, the normalisation scalars, and the EM parallel-wavenumber rule kz = 0.1 kn.
Failure matrix: one assertion per channel -- each derived scale, the sign pattern of the gyroradius, the eV-to-kelvin conversion, the normalisation selectors, and the published constants.
Precision budget, written before measurement: 1e-14 relative on the closed forms, 3e-5 on the two documented five-digit roundings (me, eV-to-joule).
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to the declared relation between the fixed deck inputs and the derived scales. Established by an independent 40-digit recomputation of every derived scalar and by comparison of the fixed constants against published values; measured deviations are at most 1e-15 relative on the derived scales. Excluded scope: any independent source for the case tables themselves (species masses beyond the published constants, densities, temperatures, B0, kz), arbitrary species model construction through case controls, and a global charge-neutral or self-consistent background equilibrium proof for the electron-only case.
known_limitations: The BONK kz values (10.0, 0.0, 1.0) are bare deck numbers with no independent source, so only their finiteness is asserted; the EM rule kz = 0.1 kn is the one relation that is checkable.
me = 9.1094e-31 and the eV-to-joule factor 1.6022e-19 are five-significant-digit roundings of CODATA-2014, not exact; they are compared at 3e-5 and stated as roundings.
